# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by tools/tool_reference.py from the server's tool definitions. Do not edit. -->

The tools UnityLudometryMCP offers to your AI assistant, by group. Only some groups are listed to the assistant at first; `tools_enable` lists more. More tools arrive as the orchestrator grows.

## `server_status`

**Server status** · group `core` · read-only, repeatable

Report this server's version, the agent protocol version it speaks, where it keeps its data (the profile root), what the connected MCP client supports, and which tool groups are enabled. Read-only; safe to call at any time.

_No parameters._

## `tools_enable`

**Enable tool groups** · group `core` · read-only, repeatable

List the tools of more groups (code, assets, runtime, instrument, live_act, mods). Only listing changes: nothing in the game or on disk. Enabling live_act lists the tools; using them still needs the agent's mode and consent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `groups` | list of string | yes | Tool groups: core, code, assets, runtime, instrument, live_act, mods. |

## `tools_disable`

**Disable tool groups** · group `core` · read-only, repeatable

Stop listing the tools of some groups, to save context. The core group always stays.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `groups` | list of string | yes | Tool groups: core, code, assets, runtime, instrument, live_act, mods. |

## `task_get`

**Get a task** · group `core` · read-only, repeatable

A task's state and progress, and its result once it has finished.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | string | yes | The task_id a tool returned. |

## `task_wait`

**Wait for a task** · group `core` · read-only, repeatable

Wait for a task to finish and return its result. Returns early with the current state and progress when the wait time is up: call it again to keep waiting.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | string | yes | The task_id a tool returned. |
| `timeout_s` | number | no | Longest wait in seconds (capped by the task.wait_poll_s limit). |

## `task_cancel`

**Cancel a task** · group `core` · changes things, repeatable

Cancel a running task. Work it already finished stays; a finished task is returned unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | string | yes | The task_id a tool returned. |

## `task_list`

**List tasks** · group `core` · read-only, repeatable

The tasks of this session (and interrupted ones from earlier sessions), oldest first, without their results.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `running` \| `succeeded` \| `failed` \| `cancelled` \| `interrupted` | no | Only tasks in this state. |

## `runtime_events`

**Runtime events** · group `runtime` · read-only, repeatable

Recent events from the game and the other providers (oldest first), including ones summarised in notices. Pass the returned last_seq as `since` next time to get only newer events.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kinds` | list of string | no | Only these event kinds (e.g. rule.fired, exception). |
| `since` | integer | no | Only events after this seq (the last_seq of a previous call). |
| `limit` | integer | no | At most this many events. |
